static_analysis_definitions.CBO: For each integration Python module: count distinct locally coupled project modules; imports and literal .py filename references; mean across Q integration modules. Excludes third-party imports; module-level proxy not exact Java CKJM CBO.
static_analysis_definitions.Cohm: For each integration module: methods=class methods (including lifecycle) or ten @server.tool decorated module functions; a related pair shares self.attribute or calls same project-local imported helper; Cohm_i=10*Ri/[Mi*(Mi-1)/2]; unweighted mean across Q modules; operationalization of manuscript formula, not validated CKJM metric.
static_analysis_definitions.Ripple_Effect: For each of five distinct externally imposed tool contract breaks, count integration .py files actually modified to restore all 50 calls; common provider mock separately recorded. New copies per scenario and architecture; real SDK client-server round trips.

experiment_constraints: Five logical client IDs are NOT five functioning LLMs
Ten tool names are deterministic local mocks, NOT real remote services
Direct integration uses one generic adapter class for all 50 logical client-tool pairs
Runtime and structural metrics may differ from original manuscript and cannot retrospectively prove its historical results
Static structural means over Q=1 vs Q=2 modules are not five independent statistical repetitions
The five contract scenarios are five change types, not randomized statistical sampling
An API gateway/adapter could equally localize changes; benefit is not MCP-specific
original_manuscript_figures: Not used as inputs or tuning targets
